essence: The goddess embodies, is, and dynamically sets in motion the sacred womb-wheel.
The goddess fully pervades the ritual diagram as its form, substance, ruler, and object of worship.
The goddess is portrayed with fierce red attributes linked to a blood-drinking ritual aspect.
The goddess participates in Bhairava conduct and is attended by Bhairava in his form as lord of beings.
Honored even by Bhava, the goddess delivers beings across the ocean of worldly existence.
